terms.definition: Allows acting as PIC for compensation/hire within the limits of the certificate and ratings held.
Landing to a designated spot/zone with controlled energy — a commercial skill standard focus.
High-bank turns requiring increased back pressure and awareness of load factor and stall speed rise.
Flight at an airspeed where further pitch-up risks stall; builds feel for the backside of the power curve (drag rise).
Disciplined visual scan using short stops across sectors so conflicting traffic is more likely to be seen.
Route, weather, alternates, and personal minimums for soaring XC — including landout options.
Commercial practical elements emphasizing precise energy and touchdown control in constrained fields.
Consistent SOP use, clear radio/briefings, and conservative go/no-go judgment when carrying passengers for hire.
